objectives.description: Shared 4-row fixture with argv-recording systemd-run stub and controllable notify-send stub
Snooze dedupe cases (exposed and required the update_lean_tree_cpu_state() fix)
Re-verification refusal cases (x3) via isolated function calls

approaches_tried.approach: Reuse assertion (g)'s enable -n kill fake-kill-log technique for the Kill-path ordering assertion
approaches_tried.reason: The Kill outcome re-invokes $SELF_SCRIPT as a genuine separate process (via the systemd-run stub's synchronous exec chain), a process boundary enable -n kill (shell-local) cannot reach -- the real builtin kill runs in that grandchild. Switched to asserting ordering via terminate_pid()'s own 'already gone' log-line sequence on fictional pids instead, which proves the identical ordering guarantee without ever risking a real signal.

approaches_tried.approach: Bare /usr/bin:/bin PATH fallback for the three degrade cases
approaches_tried.reason: Neither directory contains bash itself on this NixOS sandbox (only env/sh), so the inner bash invocation failed with its own command-not-found, and claude-refresh.sh's inherited set -e (from sourcing) silently aborted the whole suite on the resulting bare failing assignment. Replaced with a PATH-mirror-minus-one-binary technique (symlink every real PATH entry except the one dependency under test).

deviations.description: Kill-path ordering assertion technique differs from assertion (g)'s enable -n kill fake-kill-log
deviations.reason: The Kill outcome crosses a real process boundary (re-invoking $SELF_SCRIPT) that enable -n kill cannot reach. Ordering is instead proven via terminate_pid()'s own already-gone log sequence on fictional pids -- an equally conclusive, adapted technique.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- adapted ordering-proof technique for a cross-process re-invocation)*

verification_notes.shellcheck: clean, same baseline plus one pre-existing SC2016 info (intentional)
verification_notes.critical_fix: update_lean_tree_cpu_state() was silently dropping prompted/snooze_until on every detection pass, defeating prompt dedupe entirely -- fixed by merging onto the prior per-key object instead of replacing it; manually re-verified two consecutive runs now launch exactly one unit with snooze_until persisting
verification_notes.no_leaked_units: confirmed via systemctl --user list-units after every suite run in this phase
